[[Krak Flamewhip]] is one of the [[Stone Summit]]'s highest taskmasters that runs [[Sorrow's Furnace]]. After the Stone Summit's defeat and Sorrow's Furnace's destruction, he is exiled into the Far Shiverpeaks with the rest of the remaining Stone Summit.
